text:
Type: black-brown chest of three drawers
Use: storing clothes and linens, top for a lamp or decor; bedroom, living room, hallway
Style: minimalist, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: ash veneer stained black-brown with visible open grain
Colors: dark black-brown, near-black
Shape: plain boxy chest with three wide flush drawers, handleless fronts with a grip recess along the top edge, slim overhanging top, recessed plinth, crisp edges, medium visual weight
Feel: sleek, sober, calm, solid
Goes with: white or light grey walls, light oak floors, chrome or brass accents; modern or minimalist bedrooms

product.name: MALM
product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
